hooks.command: if [ -f PROGRESS.md ] || [ -f RESUME.md ]; then echo '## Project state loaded from disk:'; echo; if [ -f PROGRESS.md ]; then echo '--- PROGRESS.md ---'; cat PROGRESS.md; echo; fi; if [ -f RESUME.md ]; then echo '--- RESUME.md ---'; cat RESUME.md; fi; else echo 'No PROGRESS.md or RESUME.md in this directory — fresh session.'; fi; true
